sources.title: A Tree Viewing Platform in Chongqing, Nanshan
sources.content:
The viewing platform is located in Nan'an District, half way up the Wangjiashan Mountains with views facing Chongqing's main city across the river. It's named after a preserved Ficus virens Aiton tree over 100 years old, which is Chongqing's official city tree.

Night View Experience: Chongqing's night scenery is famously called "Little Hong Kong" and ranks as one of the three major night views in the world, alongside Manhattan and Hong Kong. The platform offers optimal viewing of illuminated bridges, rivers, and the Yuzhong District reflected in water.

Facilities & Composition: The viewing pavilion, completed in 2002, stands 28.8 meters tall with 1,570 square meters of space. It features seven floors total, upper floors serving as water bar, teahouse, and VIP rooms, an indoor sixth-floor viewing area, an open-air seventh-floor terrace, a 20-person sightseeing elevator, and over 2,000 square meters of leisure grounds with fitness programs.

Opening Hours: 9:00 AM - 10:30 PM (last entry at 10:00 PM)

Getting There: Bus routes 364, 384, or 347 from downtown. Yangtze River Cableway to Shangxin Street, then connecting buses. Climbing the historic Huangge Ancient Path (approximately 30 minutes on foot).

Visitor Recommendations: Visit on clear, sunny days, as Chongqing's frequent fog affects views. Afternoon arrival allows experiencing both daytime and nighttime scenery.

sources.title: Nanshan One Tree Viewpoint: Best Spot for Chongqing Night Views
sources.content:
Nanshan One Tree Viewpoint serves as the ultimate vantage point to experience the mesmerizing night views of Chongqing, a mountain city known for its unique terrain and Bayu cultural heritage.

Optimal Hours: 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM. Arriving one hour before sunset allows visitors to experience the sunset's golden glow, the transition as city lights activate, and the full nightscape.

Seasonal Recommendations: Spring and autumn offer clearest visibility. Post-rainfall evenings provide particularly vivid views. Foggy conditions should be avoided.

Practical Information:
Location: Nanshan Street, Nan'an District, Chongqing
Hours: Open 24/7
Admission: Free
Duration: 2-3 hours recommended

Amenities & Services: English audio guides and bilingual signage available. Free WiFi with international roaming support. Professional telescopes on main observation deck. Rest benches and indoor viewing areas. Public restrooms on-site. Teahouse with local music and tea service.

Photography Tips: Bring tripods for low-light conditions, use wide-angle lenses for panoramic shots, experiment with long exposure for light trails.

Transportation: Metro Line 3 to Nanping Station, then transfer to bus/taxi. Route 384 bus to Nanshan Botanical Garden Station. Parking lot available (15 RMB fee).

sources.title: One Tree Observation Deck: Ultimate Guide to Chongqing's Skywalk
sources.content:
The One Tree Observation Deck offers breathtaking 360-degree views of the Yangtze River, Jialing River, and the sprawling cityscape. The deck now serves as a modern vantage point with a glass-floored platform suspended 700 meters above sea level.

Opening Time: 09:00-22:30; Last admission: 22:00.
Tickets: 30 CNY.
By Subway: Line 6 to Shangxin Street Station, then take the Nanshan Tourist Shuttle.
By Bus: Route 384 to "One Tree Deck Stop".
By Taxi: Approximately 40 yuan from downtown.

The best viewing time is between 6:00 PM and 10:00 PM. Spring and Autumn offer the best air quality and clearest views.

sources.title: Single Tree Vista - Wikipedia
sources.content: Single Tree Vista, also known as Yikeshu Vista or Yikeshu Overlook, is a popular overlook park and tower located in the Nan'an District of Chongqing in Southwest China. It is known as one of the best places to see a panorama of the urban area of central Chongqing, especially the skyline of Yuzhong District, Yangtze River, Jialing River as well as a night view of the city. The night view of Chongqing is known as "Little Hong Kong" and it is also one of the three major night views in the world.

sources.title: ChongQing Nanshan Tree Viewing Platform
sources.content: A Tree Viewing Platform is named because of retaining of a Ficus virens Aiton, which is the city tree of Chongqing. And this tree is over 100 years old now. The Yikeshu observation platform is the best place to watch the night view of Chongqing. There are 364/384/347 buses from the city to Nanshan Yikeshu. You can take the Yangtze River Cableway from the city, transfer to buses after arriving at Shangxin Street. Opening hours 09:00-22:30 all year round (latest entry 22:00). Ticket price 30 yuan.

sources.title: 重庆南山一棵树观景台_百度百科
sources.content:
重庆南山一棵树观景台位于重庆市南岸区龙黄公路靠近黄桷垭路段。

开放时间：全年 09:00-22:30（最晚入园22:00）
门票价格：30元
建议游玩时长：1-2小时

发展历史：观景台前身建于1997年1月，因保留一棵重庆市树——黄桷树而得名。2003年7月正式建成，总投资1200余万元。2005年7月为迎接第五届亚太城市市长峰会，进行了全面改造。

建筑结构：观景亭6层高28米，建筑面积1570平方米。野外休闲区占地120亩。平台600平方米主平台及两个500平方米辅助平台。照明设备550盏轮廓灯、90盏水银灯。观光电梯可容纳20人。14个健身项目。

景观特色：可同时容纳500余人观山城夜景。重庆夜景素有"小香港"之称，是世界三大夜景之一，该观景台为最佳观景点。形成"日观市容市貌，夜览山城夜景"的游览格局。

交通信息：可乘坐364/384/347路公交车前往，或从市区乘长江索道至上新街后转乘相关公交。

sources.title: 一棵树观景园 - 重庆市南岸区人民政府网
sources.content: 一棵树观景园位于重庆市南岸区南山风景区内，是观赏重庆山城夜景的最佳地点。观景台因保留了一棵百年黄桷树而得名，是重庆著名的旅游景点之一。景区包括观景亭、野外休闲区等设施，可同时容纳大量游客观赏山城夜景。
